Out of the 900 blanks, exactly 720 meet the material specification, and exactly 180 have decarburized surfaces. Quality requires the 720 conforming blanks to receive 100% visual inspection before use, and the 180 nonconforming blanks must be quarantined. I should also note that the disposition record has not yet been attached to the lot.
